items.correctText: They were at home last night.

items.userAnswer: I was busy yesterday. Tom and I were playing game at yesterday at 8.00 p.m. I teached my friend to use AI at yesterday. What were you yesterday.
items.revisedAnswer: I was busy yesterday. Tom and I were playing games at 8 p.m. yesterday. I taught my friend to use AI. How were you yesterday? I was not very happy yesterday.
items.errorNote: 五处：①语法——play game 可数名词裸用（累计第 3 次）；②语法——at yesterday 出现两次，yesterday 前不加介词（跨句重复，计 2 处）；③语法——teached → taught，teach 是不规则动词；④用词——问「昨天怎么样」要用 how，不用 what；⑤标点——该句句尾应为问号。任务完成度另记：要求 1 句否定未写。
items.targetPoint: 规则动词过去式预演 + 可数名词 + 书写规范

mistakeCandidates.errorReason: 可数名词单数不能裸用（累计第 3 次犯，第 4 课首次）
yesterday / today / tomorrow 前面不加介词

mistakeCandidates.wrongText: I teached my friend to use AI
mistakeCandidates.correctText: I taught my friend to use AI
mistakeCandidates.errorReason: teach 是不规则动词，过去式是 taught 不是加 -ed
问「状态怎么样」用 how 不用 what；同题的句尾标点问题（应为问号）并入本条，见 errorNote
